decisions.reason: Wood floor cleaning soap is a low-cost complementary care item that supports the core flooring business, so it is unlikely to trigger problemistic search after only one year.
Maintenance oil fits naturally with oiled parquet and needs little slack to carry, so management will keep it while the results settle against aspirations.
The care product for oiled floors partly overlaps with the maintenance oil, but its low carrying cost and value for cross-selling favour keeping it for now.
An underlay with moisture protection is a standard accessory for floor installation and is bought with parquet, so it adds sales at little resource cost.
A high density foam underlay rounds out the accessory range, but it overlaps with the other underlay, giving a slightly higher chance of range trimming if results fall short.
Oak parquet is closest to the firm's core wood competence and anchors the whole new range, so dropping it after one year is very unlikely.
